palette.finding: Ours is bright, warm and saturated (light-blue sky, lime greens). The reference is muted, with a grey-blue overcast sky and a cooler, desaturated green.

lighting.finding: Ours has a hazy sunny day with heavy white fog that washes out the midground. The reference has flat overcast light, light fog and crisper contrast up close.

materials.finding: Our textures are clean, fine Minecraft-style pixels. The reference uses chunky, high-contrast textures with dark crack lines (cobble, leaves, bark).

shape.finding: Both use blocky voxel terrain and cube trees. The reference's tree canopies are larger and squarer.

ui.finding: Ours shows no HUD. The reference has dark translucent rounded panels for the objective, the floodwater meter and the hotbar.

vfx.finding: Only the reference shows an effect (the glowing waystone).
